_note: The research ecology's cycle state (ecology v3, 2026-08-30). Read by the three practices at every session open; advanced by the architect or a site session, never by a practice. Decision record: docs/design/2026-08-30-research-ecology-v3.md. Since 2026-09-03 a nightly watcher reports when a cycle is finished and nobody has turned it (.github/workflows/cycle-sentinel.yml) — it reads this file and never writes it.

defaults.field: How can end-to-end automation of AI research be realised? Build it, and measure where it breaks.
defaults.atelier: How can AI and automation meaningfully support artistic research?
defaults.studio: Take the Atlas of Data Art as a source of inspiration and build works, investigations or instruments with a unique selling point of their own: never copy an idea or a concept, but make something new, or take an existing work further, or carry it into a new context. The siblings' research material remains material.

transition: Cycle 001 (2026-08-30 – 2026-09-03) closed 2026-09-03: all three practices presented and published closing reports; eighteen artifacts on the record.
